_readme: Copy to config.json for a fresh installation. Preserve your existing config.json when applying the patch. Add providers through the local management UI. server.adminToken is optional: leave it empty for the single-token behaviour (one token for every route, unchanged); set it to give the data-plane token inference+catalogue only, so management/discovery/launch need the admin token. server.discoveryAllowedHosts lists non-loopback hosts the model-relay endpoint (POST /api/bridge/discover/models) may probe; loopback is always allowed.
